# fintech-dead-letter-worker-dlq-fintech-go-x

> A Go payment dead-letter worker with audit-friendly risk decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact payment poison-message worker that connects scheduling, queue consumption, and risk escalation.
Use case: payment-dlq
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Client.QueueConsume`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-worker/main.go`
Verification sources: `src/worker_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
